## Convx 2.1.6

### Download
- **`convx-2.1.6.apk`**: one APK for every 64-bit ARM phone.

### Fixes
- Each YouTube playlist showed up in Library two or three times after 2.1.5. Syncs that started at the same moment (opening the app, opening Playlists) each added their own copy. Playlists now sync one at a time, and the extra copies already saved are removed on the next sync — just open Library → Playlists.
